_comment: Small curated REFERENCE knowledge base of very well-known, publicly documented CVEs (NVD / vendor advisories). It is NOT derived from the dataset. It is used (1) to fill the CVE->software gap of the corpus with explicit provenance 'reference_kb', and (2) to flag corpus claims that contradict it. Re-verify an entry against NVD before citing it outside this project.

CVE-2021-44228.name: Log4Shell
CVE-2021-44228.weakness: remote code execution via JNDI lookup
CVE-2021-44228.summary: Remote code execution in Apache Log4j 2 through attacker-controlled log messages that trigger JNDI lookups.

CVE-2017-0144.name: EternalBlue
CVE-2017-0144.summary: Remote code execution in Microsoft SMBv1; exploited by WannaCry and NotPetya.

CVE-2014-0160.name: Heartbleed
CVE-2014-0160.summary: Missing bounds check in the TLS heartbeat extension leaks process memory.

CVE-2016-5195.name: Dirty COW
CVE-2016-5195.summary: Race condition in the Linux kernel copy-on-write mechanism allows local privilege escalation.

CVE-2014-6271.name: Shellshock
CVE-2014-6271.weakness: remote code execution via environment variables
CVE-2014-6271.summary: Bash executes trailing commands in specially crafted function definitions in environment variables.

CVE-2020-1472.name: Zerologon
CVE-2020-1472.summary: Flaw in the Netlogon secure channel lets an attacker impersonate a domain controller.

CVE-2021-34527.name: PrintNightmare
CVE-2021-34527.summary: Windows Print Spooler allows remote code execution and local privilege escalation.

CVE-2019-0708.name: BlueKeep
CVE-2019-0708.summary: Pre-authentication remote code execution in Remote Desktop Services.

CVE-2017-5754.name: Meltdown
CVE-2017-5754.summary: Lets user code read kernel memory through out-of-order execution.

CVE-2017-5715.name: Spectre
CVE-2017-5715.weakness: speculative execution side channel (branch target injection, variant 2)
CVE-2017-5715.summary: Branch target injection abuses speculative execution to leak data across security boundaries.

CVE-2017-5753.name: Spectre
CVE-2017-5753.weakness: speculative execution side channel (bounds check bypass, variant 1)
CVE-2017-5753.summary: Bounds check bypass abuses speculative execution to leak data.

CVE-2018-3646.name: Foreshadow
CVE-2018-3646.summary: L1 Terminal Fault affecting virtualisation; leaks data from the L1 cache.

CVE-2019-5736.name: runc container escape
CVE-2019-5736.summary: A malicious container can overwrite the host runc binary and gain root on the host.

CVE-2017-5638.name: Apache Struts 2 Jakarta Multipart RCE
CVE-2017-5638.summary: Content-Type header parsing flaw in Apache Struts 2 (exploited in the Equifax breach).

CVE-2018-1002105.name: Kubernetes API server privilege escalation
CVE-2018-1002105.summary: Request-handling flaw lets users escalate privileges through the Kubernetes API server.

CVE-2015-7547.name: glibc getaddrinfo overflow
CVE-2015-7547.summary: Stack-based buffer overflow in glibc DNS resolver functions.

CVE-2016-0189.name: Internet Explorer scripting engine memory corruption
CVE-2016-0189.summary: Memory corruption in the JScript/VBScript engine of Internet Explorer.

CVE-2017-8759.name: .NET Framework SOAP WSDL parser code injection
CVE-2017-8759.summary: Code injection in the .NET Framework SOAP WSDL parser, used in malicious Office documents.

CVE-2019-5786.name: Chrome FileReader use-after-free
CVE-2019-5786.summary: Use-after-free in Chrome's FileReader exploited in the wild in 2019.

CVE-2014-6332.name: Windows OLE automation array remote code execution
CVE-2014-6332.summary: OLE automation array flaw reachable through Internet Explorer VBScript.

CVE-2017-0290.name: Microsoft Malware Protection Engine remote code execution
CVE-2017-0290.weakness: remote code execution (scanning a crafted file)
CVE-2017-0290.summary: Remote code execution in the Microsoft Malware Protection Engine used by Windows Defender.
